Odisha Cabinet Approves Multiple Development Projects and Policy Changes

The Odisha state cabinet has approved the Shikshanet scheme, which will provide free WiFi to 601 colleges across the state. Additionally, the cabinet sanctioned the Upper Indravati pumped storage project in Kalahandi district, with an estimated cost of ₹4,708 crore. In a policy change, the cabinet also approved the removal of the attempt limit for the Odisha Civil Services (OCS) examination, allowing aspirants unlimited attempts.
